column_description: VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY uniquely identifying each maintenance record.
UUID REFERENCES Plant(GrowRegistry), referencing which plant is maintained.
VARCHAR(50) REFERENCES Panel(PaneMark), referencing the panel if maintenance is panel-specific.
VARCHAR(50) REFERENCES Performance(PerfRegistry), linking to performance data if relevant.
VARCHAR(100) describing the inspection method (was 'InspectionMethod'). Possible enumerations: 'Visual', 'IR Thermal', 'IV Curve', 'EL Imaging'.
VARCHAR(150) noting the inspection result (was 'InspectionResult'). Possible enumerations: 'Minor Issues', 'Major Issues', 'Pass'.
DATE specifying when inspection took place (was 'InspectionDate') (e.g., '2023-07-01').
VARCHAR(100) summarizing the maintenance schedule (was 'MaintenanceSchedule'). Possible enumerations: 'Delayed', 'Overdue', 'On Schedule'.
VARCHAR(50) describing the warranty status (was 'WarrantyStatus'). Possible enumerations: 'Claimed', 'Active', 'Expired'.
SMALLINT counting how many warranty claims have been filed (was 'WarrantyClaimCount'). Possible enumerations: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
DECIMAL(9,2) cost of maintenance in USD (was 'MaintenanceCostUSD') (e.g., 250.00).
NUMERIC(8,3) cost of cleaning in USD (was 'CleaningCostUSD') (e.g., 50.125).
DECIMAL(9,3) cost to replace components in USD (was 'ReplacementCostUSD') (e.g., 1200.500).
NUMERIC(7,2) revenue loss in USD due to downtime (was 'RevenueLossUSD') (e.g., 100.25).
